feature: Topic, journal and interest controls with account-scoped agent editing

tests.real_model: Two synthetic English/Chinese DeepSeek Flash requests returned correct selection IDs; no live preference writes.

native.android: Controls implemented; isolated QA APK compiled and two emulator UI cases passed. No new store binary uploaded.
native.ios_macos: Controls implemented in shared native source; compile/runtime and TestFlight delivery pending a separately admitted shared Mac slot.

limitations: Only the allowlisted reading preferences can be edited through this tool.
Explicit named commands work without a model; conversational edits require the existing model worker.
Exact journal choices are the supported catalog; All journals permits broader coverage.
Native settings controls are not yet distributed in a replacement store build.
